resolution_rule: Resolve the prior canonical by-worker assessments from base_state, then add new_assessments below and apply scope_updates below to the same source-bound candidate instance. No prior clean assessment is deleted or silently overwritten.

o_snapshot.delta: Across the three commits, the novelty-relevant durable change is WORK_EXECUTION_STATE checkpoint progression. The same immutable Execute invocation invoke-248450c08547af10470c50e6 still has no durable response/effect/result. No pending/configured work is counted as evaluated evidence; prior core-design novelty judgments therefore remain stable unless a clean candidate changed.

status_definitions.known: O explicitly encodes/discusses materially the same idea but no direct behavioral measurement of this clean mechanism/scope was found.
status_definitions.evaluated: O has direct explicit experiment/evidence on substantially the same mechanism under a named matched scope.
status_definitions.partially_tested: O measured or implemented a related adaptation/submechanism, but not the full clean mechanism or transfer scope.
status_definitions.uncovered: No materially equivalent O mechanism/direct test was found; generic adjacency is insufficient.

continual_learning.mechanism: Task-free continual learning with order-invariant linearized adaptation, dynamically expanded adapters, density-keyed change-point detection and likelihood routing.
continual_learning.scope: Le et al., UAI 2026; Split CIFAR-10/100, Split ImageNet-R and VTAB5T; exact tables/ablations were still a worker frontier, so no strong numeric claim is imported yet.

provenance.source: Task-Free Continual Learning via Order-Invariant Linearized Adaptation and Density-Guided Adapter Routing; official HESTIA artifact

continual_learning.uncertainty: Transfer to language-model continual learning/open-ended task discovery is unverified; quantitative component attribution remains unresolved.
continual_learning.o_comparison: O has context/source routing but no task-free continual-training adapter expansion, order-invariant linearized update, density change-point or adapter-retrieval mechanism.

cross_field.mechanism: Budget-regime-aware allocation: broad/equal allocation at low confidence, progressively concentrate as budget grows rather than applying asymptotic OCBA from the first samples.
cross_field.scope: Shao 2017 feasibility-determination theory and 10-design simulation: ALD/OCBA did not beat equal allocation until total budget about 3000 in that example; Cao et al., EJOR 2025 distinguishes finite T=O(k log k) from asymptotic omega(k log k). The 3000 crossover is not universal.
cross_field.uncertainty: Transfer from ranking-and-selection to O candidate evaluation needs a matched study.
cross_field.o_comparison: O reasons about cost/time and candidate evidence but has no OCBA/finite-budget concentration law or measured broad-to-concentrated allocation controller.

cross_field.mechanism: Event/dependency-triggered checkpoint placement to reduce rollback propagation rather than purely periodic/global checkpointing.
cross_field.scope: Xu & Netzer 1993 message-passing experiment: average rollback below one state interval/process with about 10% more checkpoints than periodic independent checkpointing; old distributed-system semantics, not modern agents.
cross_field.uncertainty: No modern agent-runtime matched replication in the worker evidence.
cross_field.o_comparison: O implements durable checkpoints at semantic/runtime boundaries and recovery, a related submechanism, but has not evaluated dependency-pattern adaptive placement versus fixed periodic checkpointing or rollback-depth/cost curves.

cross_field.mechanism: Cost-sensitive multi-task Bayesian optimization: choose proxy versus expensive target trials by information about the target per unit cost, learn correlation, and fall back to target-only when transfer is unreliable.
cross_field.scope: Swersky et al., NeurIPS 2013: MNIST target minimum about 40 min versus 100 min single-task using USPS; LDA about 6 days versus 10 using a cheaper auxiliary corpus. Direct source-optimum transfer sometimes failed. Worker also preserves a 2026 negative-transfer caveat.
cross_field.uncertainty: Relatedness must be learned/validated; no universal positive transfer.
cross_field.o_comparison: No multi-task GP or information-per-cost proxy/target experimental-design controller was found in O.

evaluation.mechanism: Meta-evaluate a judge in the exact downstream selection mode (Best-of-N/reranking), not only isolated pairwise judgments.
evaluation.scope: REFLECT 2026: process selection dropped GPT-5.4 37.1% single-pair to 0.0% Best-of-N and Gemini-3.1-Pro 24.1% to 0.0%; outcome selection GPT-5.4 38.0% to 10.0%, Gemini 32.5% to 5.0%, under the paper's controlled failure-bearing groups.
evaluation.uncertainty: Does not prove every reranker fails; group-aware calibration outside the tested construction remains open.
evaluation.o_comparison: O freezes judges/rubrics and scores action traces but has no controlled judge Best-of-N meta-evaluation.

evaluation.mechanism: Infer global juror reliability from pairwise inconsistency/cycle structure and reliability-weight jury aggregation without human labels.
evaluation.scope: ICML 2026 BT-sigma on SummEval/Topical-Chat; SummEval 1/sigma versus external judge quality PCC 72.21%, SRC 85.71%; versus cycle consistency PCC 90.29%, SRC 95.24%. Topical-Chat 8-judge SRC 59.92 versus AvgProb 54.64.

provenance.source: Who can we trust? LLM-as-a-jury for Comparative Assessment, 2026

evaluation.uncertainty: Global per-judge reliability can miss instance difficulty; transfer to agent traces untested.
evaluation.o_comparison: No Bradley-Terry reliability learning or cycle-weighted jury aggregation was found in O.

evaluation.mechanism: Calibrate citation source relevance and factual support as distinct measurement instruments with directional FPR/FNR, F1/kappa and hard-case adjudication.
evaluation.scope: 2026 citation-verifier benchmark: 624 attribution-citation pairs, 1248 criterion decisions, 378 adjudicated hard cases; source relevance GPT-5-mini F1 .908/kappa .636; factual-support examples Opus 4.6 F1 .750/kappa .701 and GPT-5-mini .710/.649.

provenance.source: Do You Need a Frontier Model as a Citation Verifier?, 2026-07

evaluation.uncertainty: Criterion/model ranking may shift by domain; disagreement-enriched hard cases are not deployment prevalence.
evaluation.o_comparison: O records provenance/evidence but has no human-calibrated LLM citation-verifier instrument with criterion-specific error rates.

evaluation.mechanism: Stress research-agent factual support as retrieval/tool depth grows, separating factuality from link validity/topical relevance.
evaluation.scope: Cited but Not Verified 2026: GPT-5.4 Fact Check 78.6% at 2 calls to 16.7% at 150 while Link Works stays 97.7-100% and Relevant 95.3-100%; Claude Opus 4.6 80.0% to 57.9%. Two-model web-search setup; mechanism mediators not fully isolated.
evaluation.uncertainty: Exact slope is not transferable; report length/source count/task difficulty can covary.
evaluation.o_comparison: O has implemented bounded/on-demand context and prior context-method cost/behavior comparisons, so a related context-interference submechanism is tested, but no retrieval-depth citation-factuality stress curve exists.

evaluation.mechanism: Let judges abstain and calibrate acceptance with finite-sample conformal/selective-risk control rather than raw confidence thresholds.
evaluation.scope: SCOPE 2026 target alpha=.10: MT-Bench Qwen7B coverage/risk .246/.097 versus naive .102/.116; reported 1.1-3.2x coverage over Trust-or-Escalate at matched risk. Cross-benchmark shift can raise risk to .157-.203.
evaluation.uncertainty: Exchangeability/distribution shift is load-bearing; agent-trajectory transfer untested.
evaluation.o_comparison: O has qualitative UNCERTAIN/fail-close behavior but no conformal risk calibration or measured coverage-risk acceptance rule.

evaluation.mechanism: Use conformal set width and local preference cycles as per-instance judge reliability diagnostics and escalate/abstain on difficult cases.
evaluation.scope: SummEval 2026: aggregate 3-cycle rates .8-4.1% yet 33-67% of documents contain a cycle; conformal set width correlates with judge-human disagreement Spearman .576, N=1918, p<1e-100.
evaluation.uncertainty: Cycle detection is diagnostic, not automatically repairable; tool/agent traces untested.
evaluation.o_comparison: No per-instance conformal prediction-set or cycle diagnostic exists in O.

evaluation.mechanism: Treat benchmark statistical resolution/power as a precondition for directional gain/regression claims; return unresolved when MDE exceeds the effect.
evaluation.scope: Resolution Diagnostics 2026: 11/40 Open LLM Leaderboard v1 pairs unresolved at alpha=.05,power=.8; MMLU-Pro 4/9 adjacent pairs unresolved, rising to 6/9 with subject clustering; full primary tables were still a worker verification frontier.

provenance.source: Resolution Diagnostics for Paired LLM Evaluation, 2026-05-28

evaluation.uncertainty: Extension to graded/multilevel agent outcomes requires an appropriate variance model.
evaluation.o_comparison: O can fail closed on missing/mismatched evidence but has no paired-design MDE/power gate; generic INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is not the same mechanism.

failure_evidence.mechanism: Procedure-aware evaluation: terminal success can conceal invalid trajectories; gate success on policy/faithfulness/execution/intent dimensions.
failure_evidence.scope: Cao et al. 2026, tau-bench Retail/Airline, GPT-5/Kimi-K2/Mistral, k=4. Retail standard success .79/.61/.68 becomes .58/.27/.16 under the six-dimension gate; Mistral>Kimi reverses to Kimi>Mistral. Authors report 27-78% corrupt successes; automatic/human judge checks about 89-95% precision/confirmation under specified subsets.
failure_evidence.uncertainty: Six binary gates are not uniquely correct; judge false positives remain.
failure_evidence.o_comparison: O implements action-trace/authority/procedure constraints and behavior-oriented evaluation, a related submechanism, but has not reproduced this six-gate tau-bench measurement.

failure_evidence.mechanism: Measure same-task repeated-run outcome consistency separately from average success, including non-sampling stochasticity where temperature is controlled.
failure_evidence.scope: ICML 2026 reliability study, 15 models, GAIA and verified tau-bench Airline, K=5. Examples: GPT-4 Turbo Airline accuracy57.7%, outcome consistency .624; GPT-5.2 60.3/.795. Cells with hidden provider temperature retain a sampling caveat.

provenance.source: Towards a Science of AI Agent Reliability, arXiv:2602.16666v3, 2026-06-02

failure_evidence.uncertainty: One scaffold per benchmark; provider-hidden temperature and alternate scaffolds can change variance.
failure_evidence.o_comparison: O requires evidence and fresh execution but no explicit K-repeat same-task consistency metric or reliability profile was found; generic multiple evidence records are insufficient.

failure_evidence.mechanism: Treat deviations at mutating/side-effect actions as a distinct critical failure surface rather than weighting all trajectory deviations equally.
failure_evidence.scope: SABER 2025 on tau-bench Airline/Retail and SWE-Bench Verified; each additional mutating-action deviation is associated with up to 92%/96% lower odds of success in Airline/Retail, while non-mutating deviations have little/no effect in the reported analysis. Association is not universal causation.
failure_evidence.uncertainty: Up-to odds reductions are model/scaffold/domain specific.
failure_evidence.o_comparison: O explicitly distinguishes mutating/irreversible external effects and imposes stronger CAS/idempotency/readback/side-effect rules, so the action-criticality design idea is already known; no SABER-style quantitative replication exists.

long_horizon.mechanism: A high-accuracy failure predictor is not a deployment criterion; evaluate recovery versus disruption on final-task outcomes and allow no-intervention in high-success regimes.
long_horizon.scope: Accurate Failure Prediction... 2026: critic AUROC .936/F1 .963 on 1372 held-out samples; HotPotQA Qwen57.0→54.7, MiniMax64.0→38.5 under best intervention; GAIA all tested backbones degrade; ALFWorld high-failure Qwen5.8→8.6 (p=.014). DeltaSuccess=p*r-(1-p)*d in the paper's accounting.
long_horizon.uncertainty: Domain/backbone dependent; predictor scaling/threshold sweeps did not rescue the reported HotPotQA setting.
long_horizon.o_comparison: O already treats interventions/candidates as hypotheses whose value is downstream behavioral/outcome change and preserves safe baselines; the principle is known, but O has no failure-critic recovery/disruption experiment.

long_horizon.mechanism: Checkpoint rollback and external-effect rollback are separate domains; classify/gate irreversible effects and track settlement so replay cannot duplicate external actions.
long_horizon.scope: Atomix 2026 addendum: recoverable-state task success can be statistically tied (tau retail fp=.10 N=114: Tx-Full58.8% vs checkpoint-replay53.5%, Fisher p≈.50), but 500 irreversible-send attempts leak 0/500 Tx-Full vs200/500 checkpoint-replay,400/500 Saga,500/500 No-Tx; misclassification leaks300/500. Combined stress fp=.30 run-clean65% vs25%. ACRFence separately observed 10/10 duplicate commits after restore vs0/10 no-checkpoint. Scope excludes semantic validation/full distributed exactly-once.
long_horizon.uncertainty: Protection depends on correct mediation/effect classification; heterogeneous irreversible endpoints can exceed tool-layer atomicity.
long_horizon.o_comparison: O implements idempotency, effect journals, CAS/readback and strict external-side-effect safety, so related settlement submechanisms exist; it has not evaluated Atomix-style effect classes/commit frontier under matched fault injection.

long_horizon.mechanism: Evaluate context compression on hidden reacquisition cost (retrieval/tool calls/steps), not terminal completion alone.
long_horizon.scope: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? 2026, fixed 24-turn deterministic planner, 3 models×2 regimes. At 5x compression no completion cell changes significantly; GPT-5.5 completion80→85 (p=1.0) while retrieval calls21.0→63.9 (p=.002); replacing retained queryable state with irrelevant content raises retrieval57% (p<.001). ALFWorld does not show the same signature.
long_horizon.uncertainty: Environment-dependent; completion and interaction-cost mechanisms must remain separate.
long_horizon.o_comparison: O Context Kernel explicitly optimizes bounded/on-demand context and measures context/cost effects, a related tested submechanism, but no compression-reacquisition causal ablation exists.

long_horizon.mechanism: Verify compression at transition boundaries by paired next-action continuations; summaries can preserve facts while mislocalizing execution state.
long_horizon.scope: TRACE 2026 AppWorld: 590 compression boundaries/4640 rollouts; POST has +.108 blocked/error actions on first action and refetch/replay +.031 after compaction. MiniMax-M3 no compression accuracy/Pass2/Pass@2=85.7/77.4/94.0, Prompting-O71.4/59.5/83.3, TRACE77.1/67.3/86.9. At 16K/8K/4K FIFO matches/slightly beats summary; summary clearly wins at 2K.
long_horizon.uncertainty: One main environment/model family; transfer Kimi result is mixed across metrics.
long_horizon.o_comparison: O has context-method/Kernel behavioral measurement and safe logical boundaries, a related adaptation, but has not run this paired compaction-boundary next-action protocol.

multi_agent.mechanism: Before instantiating multiple nominal agents for diversity, compare a single invocation producing multiple outputs; multiplicity can reduce semantic diversity at higher token cost.
multi_agent.scope: Findings ACL 2026 controlled same-perspective/output-volume divergent-thinking tasks. With SI-MO cost=1, MI-SO cost ratios 1.5885x/2.7013x/4.5098x/8.4914x at k=2/4/8/16; GPT-4.1-mini 16x1 diversity roughly15.5-21.5% below1x16 in reported rounds.

provenance.source: Single-Agent Generation Surpasses Multi-Agent Systems in Semantic Diversity

multi_agent.uncertainty: Divergent ideation does not establish superiority for decomposable tools/adversarial verification/distinct information channels.
multi_agent.o_comparison: No matched single-multi-output versus multi-agent diversity/cost experiment was found in O.

multi_agent.mechanism: Make extra workflow stages conditional on estimated difficulty/marginal value; cheap gating alone needs a stronger fallback scheduler/verifier.
multi_agent.scope: ACL 2026 LAS versus fixed AFLOW: MBPP94.2%/6643tok/134.28s vs93.7%/2430/77.99; HumanEval95.9/9391/171.56 vs94.5/5877/108.34; GSM8K95.9/17583/198.26 vs95.1/8624/125.15. MBPP Only-Gate falls to86.7%; Gate+LAS93.7%. Tested code/reasoning workflows, not arbitrary team topology.

multi_agent.uncertainty: Routing accuracy/harm rates are workflow-specific; actual adaptive team size is not demonstrated.
multi_agent.o_comparison: O dynamically routes context/skills but has no matched multi-agent/workflow depth scheduler with difficulty gate and stage-cost outcome curve; generic context routing is insufficient.

multi_agent.mechanism: Use semi-isolated evolutionary islands with local elites and selective migration to preserve lineages/diversity.
multi_agent.scope: EvoPH Findings ACL 2026, K=5 islands/T=20. Removing island+elite selection worsens relative error on all six reported heuristics, e.g. nearest-insertion4.41%→9.70%, 2-opt4.20→5.17. Ablation removes island structure and elite selection together, so migration cadence is not isolated.
multi_agent.uncertainty: TSP/bin-packing algorithm design; no isolated migration-frequency causal result.
multi_agent.o_comparison: No island-population/elite-migration evolutionary search mechanism was found in O.

multi_agent.mechanism: Run evolutionary search from noisy pairwise self-preferences by modeling posterior uncertainty and allocating comparisons near plausible optima rather than requiring a calibrated scalar reward.
multi_agent.scope: Duel-Evolve arXiv:2602.21585 reports +20pp on MathBench and >12pp over comparable iterative methods on LiveCodeBench using Bayesian Bradley-Terry plus Double Thompson Sampling. Worker found no controlled judge-noise threshold sweep.
multi_agent.uncertainty: No demonstrated failure threshold for noisy judges; test-time discrete-output optimization scope.
multi_agent.o_comparison: No uncertainty-aware Bradley-Terry/Thompson pairwise evolutionary selector exists in O.

neuroscience.mechanism: Nested modular recurrent topology enriches reciprocal/cyclic motifs and node-timescale diversity; cycle-preserving/destroying controls link recurrence to memory/multitasking.
neuroscience.scope: Nature Communications 2026 fixed reservoirs + trained linear readout. Across 100 synthetic graphs/level, higher hierarchy improves memory across alpha (p<.01,CLES>=61.15%); versus degree-random p<1e-33,CLES100%. Cycle-destroying rewiring lowers memory; preserving first-level modules+cycle counts recovers similar memory. Third hierarchy level rarely beats second.
neuroscience.uncertainty: Not end-to-end trainable deep learning; simple reservoir tasks; independent replication not established.
neuroscience.o_comparison: O's hierarchical skills/context are not neural recurrent reservoir topology; no cycle/topology memory mechanism or test is materially equivalent.

reasoning.scope: ICLR 2026 Lean Table 4: Base SFT54.2/86.0 pass@1/pass@256; GRPO71.5/81.0; alpha-DPG alpha=.5 61.4/88.5; alpha=.999 73.0/83.5. Diversity is a tradeoff, not a monotonic objective.

reasoning.scope: NeurIPS 2025 miniF2F ReProver K=8 Top-K22.4%,Random19.0%,3D-Prover24.4; K16 26.5/25.4/27.3; K32 27.8/27.4/28.2. LeanDojo Novel Premises 2000 proofs: 646 solved/32.3% versus Top-K626/31.3 and no-filter622/31.1. Diversity temperature is non-monotonic.

scientist_agents.mechanism: Maintain multiple evidence-grounded failure hypotheses, criticize them independently, then route verified causes to hypothesis/design/implementation repair instead of one monolithic reflection.
scientist_agents.scope: SAGE 2026, 12-topic five-domain ARC-Bench subset: metric-bearing recovery 5/12(42%) reflection baseline to11/12(92%); AR-Eval5.00→6.75/10; blind PhD ML review5.67 vs3.00; component ablations report MHFA removal as largest degradation. Small sample/harness.
scientist_agents.uncertainty: Need independent harness/model replication and matched cost; correlated critic/generator failure unresolved.
scientist_agents.o_comparison: O persists multiple scoped Candidates/evidence and uses failure evidence/replanning, a related submechanism, but has no SAGE-style independent multi-hypothesis causal critic/router experiment.

scientist_agents.mechanism: Typed evidence-dependency graph with weak-node localization, transactional downstream regeneration/rollback and claim-readiness gates.
scientist_agents.scope: EviGraph 2026 package-level ARC-Bench-ML: overall research performance86.45% versus about60.37% strongest compared baseline; Claim Support Rate37.85% vs27%; EDC87.73%. No clean component ablation was verified, so graph/rollback/memory credit cannot be isolated.
scientist_agents.uncertainty: Seeds/budgets/judge dependence/component attribution remain unresolved; CSR low in absolute terms.
scientist_agents.o_comparison: O implements provenance/dependency/evidence ledgers, invalidation and checkpoint/replay, related submechanisms, but not this research evidence-graph/weak-node workflow or its benchmark.

scientist_agents.mechanism: Compile natural-language scientific procedures into executable domain IR, then gate syntax, source-fidelity critique, hardware-constrained simulation and physical execution before retaining validated procedures.
scientist_agents.scope: ACRA 2026 chemistry. 150 ChemRnD procedures:99.33% syntactically valid XDL,94.67% pass later source-discrepancy+hardware simulation within <=6 repair iterations; 75-procedure memory/data ablation late-stage validation85.3%→93.3%; six literature syntheses physically executed on two robotic platforms. Two tested open-source models <=70B failed valid XDL. This is faithful reproduction, not open-ended discovery.
scientist_agents.uncertainty: Critique-stage manual fidelity/cost and non-DSL domains unresolved.
scientist_agents.o_comparison: O has generic validation/tool execution but no scientific DSL compilation+hardware simulation+physical protocol execution mechanism; generic tool safety is insufficient.

self_improvement.mechanism: Control self-improvement horizon by held-out evidence because more optimization rounds can plateau or regress and the optimum is task-dependent.
self_improvement.scope: VeRO ICML 2026 budgets B={2,4,8,16,32}. GAIA heldout .119 at B2→.195 B8 then .170 B32; TAU-Bench Retail .412→.528 monotonically through B32; MATH example validation .78→.92 without corresponding test improvement. GAIA decline is not a pure dev-overfit ablation because search entropy/prompt drift covary.
self_improvement.uncertainty: Optimal horizon is task-dependent; proposal/search-policy changes are confounded with budget.
self_improvement.o_comparison: O explicitly optimizes expected elapsed time/evidence, does not equate more attempts with progress, and allows stop/replan; the principle is known, but no VeRO budget curve is measured.

self_improvement.mechanism: Treat repeatedly exposed dev/selection scores as an adaptive-data-analysis channel; bound information leakage/query budget or use reusable/anytime-valid holdout methods plus a fresh sealed test.
self_improvement.scope: Dwork et al. NeurIPS 2015 synthetic null n=10000,d=10000: ordinary reused holdout reports >63% accuracy at k=500 despite true accuracy <=50%; Thresholdout prevents the demonstrated holdout overfit. Transfer to agent evolution is a hypothesis, not direct agent evidence.

provenance.source: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse, NeurIPS 2015

self_improvement.uncertainty: DP/Thresholdout machinery should not be transplanted wholesale without agent-specific cost/utility tests.
self_improvement.o_comparison: O protects held-out evidence but no explicit reusable-holdout leakage budget/Thresholdout/anytime-valid correction for repeated adaptive candidate queries was found.

self_improvement.mechanism: Use paired e-process anytime-valid candidate-vs-incumbent acceptance under optional stopping to control false commits and stop evaluation early.
self_improvement.scope: PACE 2026 Qwen2.5 0.5B-3B prompt evolution on GSM8K/SVAMP/ARC-Challenge. Greedy commits30-42% false and10-33% harmful edits in a controlled beneficial-edit setup; PACE reports0/5 audit-labelled false commits. Stochastic/no-gain greedy commits13-21 spurious/run (72-100% false), hurting 0.5B by4.9 points; PACE nearly no-ops. Early stopping saves about18% evaluations. Per-decision control is not automatically run-level FWER.
self_improvement.uncertainty: Small prompt-level testbed; full-text details/audit protocol remained a worker frontier.
self_improvement.o_comparison: O uses candidate regression/held-out gates but no e-process/optional-stopping false-commit control.

self_improvement.mechanism: Maintain immutable self-edit certificates and a horizon-free global error-spend ledger to target familywise false-commit risk across an open-ended edit lineage.
self_improvement.scope: SEA 2026 Algorithm4 CTHS/e-process architecture. SWE-bench Verified 52-instance subset/four bases; deliberate no-op-composite control GLM5.2 24→28 and GPT29→34, best34/52. Single-run; several slow-loop guarantees validated offline; paper explicitly says full endogenous proposer/distribution-shift familywise safety is unproved.

provenance.source: Self-Evolving Agents with Anytime-Valid Certificates, arXiv:2607.00871

self_improvement.uncertainty: Mathematical components do not prove safety of endogenous self-evolution; small/single-run empirical scope.
self_improvement.o_comparison: O has immutable evidence/decision ledgers but no statistical global delta spending/familywise certificate mechanism across edits.

self_improvement.mechanism: Use anytime-valid e-process confidence intervals with informative sampling/surrogate assistance to stop expensive evaluation at target precision without repeated-peek CI failure.
self_improvement.scope: CELEUS 2026. At nominal alpha=.05, CER-EVAL miscoverage .161 versus e-process methods .021-.030 in the diagnostic. Median samples to epsilon=.05: SST-2 6889→3156(-54%), MMLU8144→3242(-60%), AG News15336→5840(-62%). It estimates one system; it does not solve candidate-lineage multiplicity.
self_improvement.uncertainty: Conditional-unbiasedness assumptions and surrogate guidance under candidate-dependent sampling need matched validation.
